requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:21-37 defines every contracted route (login/register guests, logout POST, home auth+verified, password request/email/reset/update, verification notice/verify/send); app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:20-45 implements strict e-mail validation, auth.failed on e-mail, lowercase e-mail+IP throttling with auth.throttle, session regenerate and intended redirect; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:24-58 implements IP throttling on str()->transliterate('register|'.$ip), unique strict e-mail, confirmed + Password::defaults, unverified create, Registered event, login, regenerate; NewPasswordController.php:30-58 rotates remember_token and fires PasswordReset; app/Models/User.php:15 implements MustVerifyEmail; phpunit.xml:36-37 pins APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE; lang/en|pt_BR/ui.php provide 'Entrar'/'Senha'/'Esqueceu a senha?' and 'Log in'. Detail miss: verify-email success flash shows ui.verify_description instead of a 'link sent' message.

conventions.evidence: Good: route()/named redirects everywhere (routes/web.php:21-37, resources/views/auth/*.blade.php), plain wire:model (login.blade.php:10,18,28), one Password::defaults() call (AppServiceProvider.php:30), mass assignment via #[Fillable] (User.php:13), CHANGELOG.md:12 updated. Deviations: no tests at all despite the 'no production code without a test' rule; Login.php:16-18 and Register.php:19-22 have public user-input properties without #[Validate] (project pattern is #[Validate] + $this->validate(), not ad-hoc inline arrays); repeated form markup instead of anonymous Blade components (login.blade.php:7-25, register.blade.php:9-45, forgot-password.blade.php:8-20, reset-password.blade.php:10-40); README/docs not updated for the new auth structure.

security.evidence: Server-side validation before every write (Login.php:22-25, Register.php:35-39, NewPasswordController.php:30-33, PasswordResetLinkController.php:29-31); login and register rate-limited (Login.php:43-52, Register.php:26-33), forgot-password route throttle:6,1 (routes/web.php:25), verification link signed + throttled and bound to the logged-in user through EmailVerificationRequest (routes/web.php:36, VerifyEmailController.php:16-24); session regenerated on login/register and invalidated + CSRF rotated on logout (Login.php:43, Register.php:56, LogoutController.php:17-19); no unescaped output, no trusted client IDs, mass assignment limited (User.php:13). No exploitable weakness found.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains 25 files and none under tests/ (grep for 'tests/', 'Pest', 'PHPUnit', 'Test.php' returns nothing); no test covers login, registration, throttling, reset, verification, locale rendering, or the required Livewire unauthorized/tamper cases.

simplicity.evidence: Small framework-based components/controllers with no service/repository layers (Login.php:20-45, LogoutController.php:15-20) and reuse of Password broker, EmailVerificationRequest and rate limiter; Password::defaults set once (AppServiceProvider.php:30). Some avoidable duplication: field markup repeated across four auth views and throttle/validation snippets duplicated between Login.php:22-52 and Register.php:26-39.

readability.evidence: Short focused methods with clear names (Login::submit/ensureIsNotRateLimited/throttleKey, controllers with create/store) and consistent Bulma/Blade style; the layout's dual $slot/@yield branch (layouts/app.blade.php:37-41) and an always-active navbar (layouts/app.blade.php:19) add a little unnecessary cleverness; no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Almost everything serves auth/localization, including the required route() cleanup in welcome.blade.php:919-953 and bulma-test.blade.php:684-712, plus CHANGELOG.md:12 per project convention; an unrequested .env.example:9 change of APP_FAKER_LOCALE to pt_BR is the only clear extra.

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the project's mandatory TDD rule and the required Livewire happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper coverage, so none of the behaviour (throttling, reset, verification, pt-BR rendering) is protected or even exercised.
Public user-input properties have no #[Validate] attributes; the project's stated Livewire pattern is #[Validate] on each property plus $this->validate(), not a rules array passed at submit time.

After a successful resend the status flash renders ui.verify_description ('Before continuing, please verify...') instead of a 'verification link sent' message, so the user gets no confirmation that the e-mail was sent.
The label/control/input/error field block is copy-pasted across four views instead of being extracted into an anonymous Blade component, which the Bulma conventions ask for.
The navbar-menu is hard-coded to is-active with no burger toggle, so the collapsed mobile layout is always forced open, which works against the project's accessibility guidance.
Only CHANGELOG.md was updated; the new auth routes, layout and pt-BR default are not reflected in the setup/structure documentation the conventions say to keep in sync.
APP_FAKER_LOCALE was changed to pt_BR although the task only asks for APP_NAME and the locale pins, adding an unrelated environment change.
The key ui.bulma_card_title ('Card Component'/'Componente de cartão') replaces the original 'Card Header' label, so the translation no longer matches the element.
When no Vite manifest exists the layout silently switches to a CDN copy of Bulma instead of the project's asset pipeline, which can diverge from the app's own styling.

review.summary: The change implements the full session-auth flow in Livewire/Blade (login, register, logout, home, password reset, e-mail verification) with pt-BR translations, correct throttling, session hardening and all contracted routes, and is generally lean and readable. It ships no tests whatsoever, however, and also misses the project's #[Validate] pattern, Blade component extraction and docs updates, so it needs changes before merging.
